countries.reasoning: China is the dominant global producer of yttrium based on USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2024 data; production figures for 2023 are well documented, giving very high confidence.
The US has stable yttrium production mainly from Mountain Pass mine with good data from USGS 2024; slight uncertainty due to market fluctuations.
Malawi's production is growing from rare earth projects reported by recent mining reports and USGS; figures are reliable but less documented than China/US.
Australia produces yttrium mainly from rare earth projects, with reported outputs from government data and industry reports; reliable but smaller scale.
India produces yttrium primarily as a byproduct of monazite sands; production is documented but data has moderate reporting gaps and variability.
